question: Which of the following are listed advantages of turboprop engines over other engine types?

question: What is a characteristic of a free power-turbine engine like the Pratt & Whitney PT-6?

correct_answers.text: The propeller is driven by a separate turbine through reduction gearing.

wrong_answers.text: The propeller is directly connected to the engine turbine.
The propeller cannot be feathered in flight.
The engine uses a single turbine for both the compressor and propeller.
The propeller speed is directly linked to engine rpm.
The engine uses only axial flow compressor stages.
The engine has a single exhaust port.
The propeller lever controls the engine power.
